name: Dark ink
description: Thin the dark-pixel mask to centerlines; draw with one fixed-width black pen.

name: More ink
description: Same centerline method, with a lighter cutoff to retain more marks.

name: Fine edges
description: Gaussian smoothing, Canny edges, then connected pen paths. May outline both sides of an ink stroke.

name: Coarse edges
description: More smoothing and stronger edge thresholds; a geometric detail-reduction baseline.

name: Black · 35%
description: Two hatch directions. Density scales requested coverage before spatial screening.

name: Black · 70%
description: The same hatch screen at twice the requested coverage.

name: CMY · 35%
description: Ideal cyan, magenta and yellow separations, at 15°, 75° and 135°. Uncalibrated ink mixing.

name: CMY · 70%
description: The same ideal CMY screen at twice the requested coverage.

name: Ink + CMYK · 50%
description: Dark centerlines plus CMYK shading. Existing black stroke footprints reduce the shading demand; no semantic recognition.

name: AM · black
description: Fixed wave frequency; darkness increases amplitude. Arc-length lookup; lifts in near-white regions.

name: FM · black
description: Fixed amplitude; darkness increases frequency. Phase is integrated continuously; lifts in near-white regions.

name: AM × FM · black
description: Amplitude and frequency grow together. Gently bent rows and staggered phases; lifts in near-white regions.

name: AM · zigzag
description: Triangular-wave reference: amplitude changes on a fixed cycle. A sharper alternative to sine waves.

name: AM × FM · CMY
description: Combined modulation in three pen colors at 0°, 60° and 120°. Uncalibrated color mixing; lifts in near-white regions.

name: Recovered ink
description: Multiscale dark valleys with lighter surroundings on both sides. One centerline per narrow ink band; broad fills and one-sided color edges are excluded. Experimental fixed-width recovery.

name: AM × FM + ink
description: Full-image CMY waves plus recovered black centerlines. Actual black footprints reduce CMY demand. Light areas progressively omit rows below the carrier floor.

name: Edge CMY · 0.25″
description: Color and tonal boundaries attract CMY waves on both sides, retaining each side’s source color. Contrast-weighted cosine fade to white over 0.25 inch; no black strokes.

name: Edge CMY + ink · 0.25″
description: The same 0.25-inch edge-local color fade, plus recovered black centerlines. Color ink goes near significant hue or tonal boundaries; broad interiors stay white.

name: Edge CMY + ink · 0.5″
description: A broader 0.5-inch fade on each side of color and tonal boundaries, plus recovered black centerlines. Same peak demand as the 0.25-inch versions; more context inside regions.

name: Fainter marks
description: Lower contrast and darkness cutoffs retain faint marks. Same stroke-size range as Recovered ink; short-path cutoff reduced to 0.20 mm.

name: Fainter + wider
description: Same sensitivity as Fainter marks, with larger analysis scales for heavy eyebrows and frame strokes. Still rejects broad flat regions.

name: Weak continuations
description: Follow weaker ridge segments only when connected to a stronger mark. No straight-line guessing across gaps; isolated faint marks may be lost.

name: Fainter + wider · fine pen
description: Identical recovery settings to Fainter + wider, with a 0.15 mm pen. Tests physical mark overlap; does not invent missing source detail.

name: Full screen · 70%
description: Full-image AM/FM at 70% demand, plus Fainter + wider strokes. Monochrome sources use K alone; color sources use CMY plus recovered K. Reference for the ink index.

name: Edges · 0% interior
description: Edge emphasis with a 0.25-inch fade to white; Fainter + wider strokes. Color uses CMY plus K, monochrome uses only K.

name: Edges · 25% interior
description: Retain 25% of peak ink demand in region interiors, rising to full emphasis at strong color or tone edges. Same recovered strokes as the other screen columns.

name: 25% interior · scattered breaks
description: The 25% interior blend with seeded stop/start intervals throughout the tonal range. Dark rows also lift; modulation compensates where possible. No synchronized whole-row deletion.

name: Full screen · scattered breaks
description: Full-image 70% screen with the same distributed interruptions. Compare with Full screen to judge banding, worm-like fragments and extra pen lifts independently of edge emphasis.

name: Recovery reference
description: The recovery preferred in this row’s feedback (shown in the detail view). Game Night retains the recovery from its preferred screen. Reference for the ink index.

name: Fainter still
description: Lower the contrast, darkness and response thresholds further. Retain isolated faint candidates without requiring a strong seed; keep scale-relative spur rejection.

name: Fine detail · 0.30 mm
description: Fainter still with smaller analysis scales and the source’s native pixels (up to 2048, no upscaling). Keep shorter runs and simplify less. Tests existing small detail, not invented higher-resolution text.

name: Fine detail · 0.15 mm
description: Same fine-detail recovery and source pixels as the 0.30 mm column, rendered with a 0.15 mm pen to separate detection losses from physical stroke overlap.

name: Full · preferred ink
description: Full-image AM/FM at 70% demand plus the row’s preferred black recovery. Same peak demand, pen and black paths as all new edge/interior comparisons.

name: Interior 25% · 0.25″
description: 25% interior floor, fading over 0.25 inch from strong boundaries. Peak demand stays at 70%, matching the Full reference.

name: Interior 50% · 0.25″
description: Retain half of peak demand in interiors to preserve more of the source’s color and mood. Same 70% peak demand and preferred black recovery.

name: Interior 75% · 0.25″
description: Retain three quarters of peak demand in interiors. A gentler edge emphasis, compared at the same 70% peak demand and preferred recovery.

name: Interior 25% · 0.5″
description: Same 25% floor and 70% peak, with a longer half-inch transition from edges into the interior. Compare with the 0.25-inch version to isolate fade distance.

name: Selected recovery
description: The latest per-image recovery choice, including the chosen black pen diameter. Principal’s Office and Game Night keep the quieter earlier recovery; Visitor remains unresolved.

name: Full · selected K
description: Full 70% AM/FM with the latest preferred recovery and its actual black pen width. CMY stays at 0.30 mm; selected fine K stays at 0.15 mm.

name: 75% interior · 0.25″
description: 75% interior at a matched 70% peak, with the selected black strokes and diameter. Reference for the longer falloff.

name: 75% interior · 0.5″
description: The requested softer half-inch fade with 75% retained in the interior. Same 70% peak, same K geometry and same per-ink widths as the other screens.

name: 25% interior · 0.25″
description: Retain the light edge/interior choice for Game Night, using its quieter recovery and K-only AM/FM. Same matched peak as the color comparisons.

name: Ridge reference · 0.15 mm
description: Previous fine-detail ridge detector, held as the lettering reference. Inspect the upper-right panel at the same zoom as the connected-ink alternatives.

name: Connected ink · dark
description: Threshold at 128/255, thin the source ink and trace every branch, loop and isolated dot. Veto broad interiors after thinning. No ridge test, minimum-run cutoff or OCR.

name: Connected ink · inclusive
description: Same connected-ink tracer at 180/255, retaining lighter antialiased links. Uses a 0.15 mm pen; thin marks remain even when connected to broad ink.

name: Connected ink · 0.30 mm
description: Same inclusive connected-ink geometry with a 0.30 mm pen, to test whether physical stroke overlap closes the small spaces in letters.

name: Selected recovery
description: Retain the current recovery selections while studying highlight screening and small lettering.

name: Full · reference
description: Current full-screen treatment, including its 4% near-white cutoff. Selected recovered K stays fixed.

name: Full · lower cutoff
description: Same row-selection treatment with the near-white cutoff lowered from 4% to 0.4%. This separates cutoff changes from longitudinal diffusion.

name: Highlight diffusion · 0.8 mm
description: Carry ink error along light rows in nominal 0.8 mm packets. Account for round caps; retain continuous AM/FM where demand reaches one straight carrier. Same 0.4% cutoff as the adjacent control.

name: Highlight diffusion · 1.6 mm
description: Carry ink error along light rows in nominal 1.6 mm packets. Account for round caps; retain continuous AM/FM where demand reaches one straight carrier. Same 0.4% cutoff as the adjacent control.

name: Native · 0.15 mm
description: Connected dark ink at threshold 128. Vary physical pen width separately from ordinary 2× cubic interpolation; interpolation adds no source information. All four use 450 dpi previews for detailed comparison.

name: Native · 0.075 mm
description: Connected dark ink at threshold 128. Vary physical pen width separately from ordinary 2× cubic interpolation; interpolation adds no source information. All four use 450 dpi previews for detailed comparison.

name: 2× cubic · 0.15 mm
description: Connected dark ink at threshold 128. Vary physical pen width separately from ordinary 2× cubic interpolation; interpolation adds no source information. All four use 450 dpi previews for detailed comparison.

name: 2× cubic · 0.075 mm
description: Connected dark ink at threshold 128. Vary physical pen width separately from ordinary 2× cubic interpolation; interpolation adds no source information. All four use 450 dpi previews for detailed comparison.

name: Zhang–Suen · reference
description: The prior 2× cubic mask and Zhang–Suen centerlines, with the 0.075 mm diagnostic pen. Same mask and pen as the other columns.

name: Guo–Hall
description: The identical binary mask, thinned with Guo–Hall. Trace this skeleton directly; never run Zhang–Suen over it afterward.

name: Medial axis
description: Use distance from the ink boundary to form the medial axis of the identical mask. Fixed seed resolves ties; restore tiny junction cavities only where the source has solid ink. Same fixed-width pen; no guessed letters.

name: Ink-shape fill · control
description: Bypass thinning: densely fill the same ink mask with the same 0.075 mm pen. Preserve white holes with conservative pen clearance. This tests lost shape and stroke weight, at the cost of many more paths; it is not single-stroke recovery.

name: Smooth · bounded
description: Fit Zhang–Suen paths within 0.12 mm; keep endpoints, short arms and tiny loops. Accept changed paths only when the whole pen fits the source ink.

name: Smooth + stroke weight
description: Same fitted centerlines, plus overlapping parallel passes to recover local ink width. Added passes remain in source ink and overlap their predecessor.

name: Joined fill · fewer lifts
description: The same dense fill, with neighboring rows joined only inside their existing painted footprints. Keep every original run; small retraces trade extra pen travel for fewer lifts. No new source-ink area is added.

name: Joined fill · 0.25 mm · 11×17
description: Joined fill regenerated with a 0.25 mm pen at the largest aspect-preserving size inside 11×17-inch paper with 0.75-inch margins. Centered; choose portrait or landscape to maximize size. The conservative full-pen containment policy can omit marks too narrow for this pen.

name: Screen only
description: AM/FM and highlight diffusion alone; same turquoise role, 0.25 mm test pens and paper size as the other columns.
